# Expense Split

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the project's architecture, current-stack discovery, validation commands, data invariants, and safety boundaries.

Use Expo Router and the existing feature modules rather than introducing another navigation or state stack. Preserve local-only guest access and account-scoped shared-group sync. Verify current Expo APIs against SDK-matched documentation.

Keep fixes small, explain the main learning point briefly, and report checks actually performed. Use relevant path-specific instructions and project skills; select specialized agents only when their role helps the task. Never expose environment values or perform cloud/deployment actions without explicit authorization.
